cl.c: Data sheet page 1: Description
cl.x: SikaTile®-374 Mega Pro is a fine white, polymer fortified, flexible, sand and silica free cement-based tile adhesive, suitable for tile and stone internal wall tiling applications.

cl.x: Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (March 2025, Version 01.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Substrate Quality
s: All substrates shall meet minimum deflection standards outlined in the Australian Standards AS 3958:2023

All substrates shall be free from loose friable materials, dust, debris, release agents, curing compounds, grease, sealers and other contaminating materials. Contaminated substrates must be mechanically prepared to expose at least 80% of the original substrate.
For substrates that require a levelling compound use a suitable Sika® faring coat /skim coat.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Substrate Quality > CONCRETE SUBSTRATES
cl.x: New concrete shall be cured for 28 days and be left with a wood float finish. Steel trowel finished concrete is generally acceptable if the concrete allows water penetration. Concrete above 35Mpa shall be mechanically prepared.

cl.t: Substrate quality - Cement boards and sheeting
cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Substrate Quality > CEMENT BOARDS AND SHEETING
cl.x: All boards and sheets must be fixed in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions and specifically designed for tiling.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Substrate Quality > RENDERS
cl.x: Cement-based renders must be installed as per AS 3958:2023 and left for a minimum 24 hours prior to tiling. Renders may need longer drying time in cold climtes.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Substrate Preparation
cl.x: Substrates shall be primed prior to adhesive application.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Mixing
s: Pour clean cool water into a mixing bucket and gradually pour the the SikaTile®-374 Mega Pro powder into the bucket and stir with a mixing drill).
Mix for 2-3 minutes to a smooth lump free homogeneous consistency.
Allow the product to stand (slake) for 5 minutes then restir for an additional minute.
Do not add more water.
Restirring the mixture may be required during the adhesives pot life.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Application
s: Tiles shall be fixed in accordance to with AS 3958:2023
Ensure the backs of tiles are clean and free from dust and contaminates.
Apply the adhesive to the substrate with the appropriate sized notched trowel to achieve coverage requirement on both substrate and the back of the tile.
Tiles may require back-buttering to achieve minimum coverage requirements.
Apply the adhesive with a notched trowel in a single direction.
Apply the tile, while pressing into the wet adhesive, break the ridges with the tile to fully bed the tile into the adhesive.
It is advisable to periodically check the backs of the tiles for adhesive coverage requirements as the AS3958:2023.
Only apply as must adhesive that can be covered prior to adhesive skinning. If skinning occurs remove and replace with fresh adhesive.
Remove any excess adhesive from the face of the tile with a damp sponge and ensure grout joint are of uniform depth.
Movement, expansion and control joints must be installed as per AS 3958:2023.
Allow adhesive to dry prior to grouting.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Cleaning Of Equipment
cl.x: Tools and equipment can be cleaned with water while the adhesive is still wet.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Limitations Of Use
s: Test in an inconspicious area first.
Not suitable for applications over tongue and groved timber flooring, plywood, medium density fibre board, or masonite.
Not suitable for moisture sensitive stone installations
Not suitable to be applied directly over solvent based waterproof membranes.
The performance of cement based adhesives will be comprimised when used above 35°C and under 5°C.
Due to external influences beyond our control Efflorescence is beyond the control of the manufacturer.
Not suitable for external applications
Not suitable in submersed applications such as pools or spas.
Contact Sika Australia for applications not mentioned in this document or if further information is required.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Further Documentation
cl.l: Use product in accordance with Australian Standards AS 3958:2023 The Installation of Ceramic & Stone Tiles. It is essential to plan the area to be tiled, with inclusion of movement joints, in accordance with the relevant Australian Standard . Failure to do so may result in drummy or lifting tiles. Make sure normal building or surface movement is accommodated by installing movement joints as follows:
s: Over movement joints in the substrate
At a junction between different substrate materials
At fixtures interrupting the tile surface e.g. columns
At internal vertical corners
Around the perimeter of the tiling system
At a maximum of 4.5m centres, in a grid pattern
Movement joints should be kept free from dirt and adhesive
All movement joints can be filled with a suitable Sika sealnt and suitable backing rod or backing tape.
